results.question: How much revenue did our dresses bring in?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount))::numeric, 2) AS dress_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND lower(p.product_type) = 'dress';

results.question: What is our overall gross profit margin?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum((l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * l.quantity) / sum((l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount) / 1.1) * 100, 2) AS gross_profit_margin_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN variants v ON l.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND v.cost IS NOT NULL
results.answer: Your overall gross profit margin is 58.32%. This was calculated by taking your total ex-GST revenue minus your product costs, divided by total revenue for all valid orders. Please note that this calculation excludes any product variants that were missing cost data in the system.
results.assumptions: Calculated overall gross profit margin as total ex-GST gross revenue minus total cost, divided by total ex-GST gross revenue, for all non-voided orders. Excluded variants with NULL cost.

results.question: What are our top 5 products by gross profit?

results.answer: Your top five products by gross profit are the One-Piece Swimsuit at $165,884.48, Shirt Dress at $130,441.22, Straw Hat at $108,854.01, High-Rise Jeans at $104,531.12, and Wool Coat at $89,912.11. These figures cover all non-voided orders from October 2025 through September 2026. Please note that product variants with missing cost data were excluded from these calculations.
results.assumptions: Calculated gross profit as (line revenue ex-GST) minus (unit cost ex-GST * quantity) for non-voided orders across the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30). Variants with NULL cost were excluded.

results.question: What is our net revenue after refunds?

results.answer: Your total net revenue after refunds for the period from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026, is $3,205,298.79 AUD. This total is calculated by subtracting all refunds from the revenue of non-voided orders across the entire data period.
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: Total net revenue across the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30), calculated as total non-voided order revenue minus total refunds.

results.question: What percentage of orders had a refund?
results.sql:
WITH order_stats AS ( 
  SELECT 
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS refunded_orders 
  FROM orders o 
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id 
  WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided'
)
SELECT 
  total_orders, 
  refunded_orders, 
  ROUND(100.0 * refunded_orders / NULLIF(total_orders, 0), 2) AS percentage_refunded 
FROM order_stats;
results.answer: Out of your 17,340 total non-voided orders, 5.7% of them had at least one refund, totaling 988 refunded orders across the data period. This analysis assumes that voided orders were correctly excluded and that each order with a refund is counted once regardless of the number of items refunded.
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: What percentage of non-voided orders had at least one refund across the entire data period (Oct 1, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026)? Voided orders are excluded.

results.question: On average, how many days after the order are refunds issued?

results.question: Compare weekend revenue with weekday revenue.

results.answer: Weekdays brought in more revenue than weekends, with weekdays generating $2,147,980.22 across 11,153 orders compared to $1,173,950.49 from 6,187 orders on weekends. This comparison assumes a standard five-day weekday and two-day weekend schedule based on Australia/Sydney time, and excludes all voided orders.

results.question: What is the best-selling product in each product type?
results.sql: WITH ranked_products AS (SELECT lower(p.product_type) AS product_type, p.title AS product_title, sum(ol.quantity) AS total_units_sold, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(p.product_type) ORDER BY sum(ol.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM products p JOIN variants v ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN order_lines ol ON v.variant_id = ol.variant_id JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY lower(p.product_type), p.title) SELECT product_type, product_title, total_units_sold FROM ranked_products WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC;
results.answer: Your best-selling products by type range from 4,043 units for the swimwear One-Piece Swimsuit down to 526 units for the knitwear Merino Crew Jumper. These totals cover all non-voided orders from October 2025 through September 2026. This ranking is based on total units sold, assuming all product types were tracked consistently across the entire year.
results.assumptions: Ranked products by total units sold within each product type for all non-voided orders across the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30). Product types are normalized to lowercase.
